question: Tansen, the famous musician, often sang in the court of which ruler?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Akbar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tansen:-**

 
 
• **He was a legendary Indian musician who is considered one of the greatest exponents of Hindustani classical music. **
 
• He was a composer, vocalist, and instrumentalist, and is credited with creating many of the ragas and talas that are still used today.
 
• Tansen was also a poet and wrote many devotional songs.
 
• **He was a court musician for the Mughal emperor Akbar, and his music was said to have such a powerful effect that it could even soothe wild animals.**
 
• Tansen is still revered in India today, and his tomb in Gwalior is a popular pilgrimage site. 
 
 
 
• **Akbar:-**
 
 
• **He was the third Mughal emperor, who reigned from 1556 to 1605. **
 
• Considered one of the greatest monarchs in Indian history, Akbar was a patron of the arts and culture.
 
• He also established a strong central government and expanded the Mughal Empire to its greatest extent
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sher Shah Suri:-**

 
 
• He was the founder of the Sur Empire in India.
 
• He ruled from 1540 to 1545.
 
• He is considered one of the most able and successful rulers in Indian history.
 
 
 
• **Sultan Firoz Shah Tughlaq:-**
 
 
• He was a Muslim ruler from the Tughlaq dynasty.
 
• He reigned over the Sultanate of Delhi from 1351 to 1388.
 
• He was a descendant of Ghiyas ud din Tughlaq, the founder of the dynasty.
 
 
 
• **Allauddin Khilji:-**
 
 
• He was the second sultan of the Khilji dynasty, which ruled the Delhi Sultanate in India.
 
• He was a skilled military leader and administrator, and he expanded the Delhi Sultanate to its greatest extent
